name: The Eternal War
description: 78 tarot cards, 12 matching horoscope cards, a matching card back, and an illustrated companion guidebook.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.scene: A human pilgrim with white rose and small white dog steps at a broken bridge; an angel guides and a demon whispers
cards.subtitle: The First Choice
cards.coreMeaning: A soul enters the war before understanding its cost. The angel offers guidance, the demon offers certainty, and the pilgrim must choose without surrendering judgment.
cards.deeperTension: Trust becomes wisdom when it notices consequences; fear can disguise itself as prudence.
cards.upright: Begin with a modest, honest step. Seek counsel, accept uncertainty, and keep responsibility for the choice.
cards.shadowReversed: Recklessness or paralysis may be letting another voice choose for you. Check the real stakes before leaping or withdrawing.
cards.reflection: Which first step honors both your hope and your responsibility?
cards.artworkPrompt: A human pilgrim with white rose and small white dog steps at a broken bridge; an angel guides and a demon whispers
cards.reversed: Recklessness or paralysis may be letting another voice choose for you. Check the real stakes before leaping or withdrawing.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.scene: A human mage channels heaven and hell through one raised hand and one lowered hand; on altar exactly one wand, cup, sword, pentacle
cards.subtitle: Power With Purpose
cards.coreMeaning: The Magician stands where intention becomes action. The same tools can heal a divided world or manipulate it; power receives its moral direction from how it is used.
cards.deeperTension: Skill does not establish innocence. Good intentions need transparent methods.
cards.upright: Use what you know to make one helpful change. State your purpose clearly and allow others to question your methods.
cards.shadowReversed: Charm, scattered effort, or hidden motives may be taking the place of honest work. Match your promises to evidence.
cards.reflection: Who benefits from the way you are using your influence?
cards.artworkPrompt: A human mage channels heaven and hell through one raised hand and one lowered hand; on altar exactly one wand, cup, sword, pentacle
cards.reversed: Charm, scattered effort, or hidden motives may be taking the place of honest work. Match your promises to evidence.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.scene: A veiled angelic oracle sits between ivory and obsidian pillars, holding a sealed scroll before an eclipse
cards.subtitle: The Quiet Witness
cards.coreMeaning: The oracle guards a threshold between revelation and secrecy. Her stillness invites attention to subtle contradictions before the loudest voice claims the truth.
cards.deeperTension: A strong feeling is worth examining, but it is not proof of another person's motives.
cards.upright: Listen carefully, observe patterns, and allow unfinished knowledge time to develop. Protect privacy without abandoning accountability.
cards.shadowReversed: Silence may conceal avoidance, or suspicion may be presenting itself as intuition. Look for evidence and speak when harm requires action.
cards.reflection: What do you know, what do you suspect, and what remains unknown?
cards.artworkPrompt: A veiled angelic oracle sits between ivory and obsidian pillars, holding a sealed scroll before an eclipse
cards.reversed: Silence may conceal avoidance, or suspicion may be presenting itself as intuition. Look for evidence and speak when harm requires action.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.scene: A crowned winged guardian nourishes a garden sheltering human children while demonic thorns threaten beyond its walls
cards.subtitle: Mercy Made Tangible
cards.coreMeaning: The Empress creates sanctuary in a world at war. Her goodness is expressed through food, shelter, care, and the patient protection of vulnerable life.
cards.deeperTension: Care becomes control when it makes dependence the price of belonging.
cards.upright: Nourish a relationship or project through practical support. Include your own needs in the life you cultivate.
cards.shadowReversed: Overgiving, possessiveness, or neglect may be weakening the sanctuary. Care for others without making yourself their only refuge.
cards.reflection: What would care look like if it supported everyone's freedom?
cards.artworkPrompt: A crowned winged guardian nourishes a garden sheltering human children while demonic thorns threaten beyond its walls
cards.reversed: Overgiving, possessiveness, or neglect may be weakening the sanctuary. Care for others without making yourself their only refuge.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.scene: An armored angel king on stone throne protects a city; a crimson demonic conqueror is reflected in his polished shield
cards.subtitle: Authority That Protects
cards.coreMeaning: The Emperor defends a city while confronting the conqueror he could become. His shield asks whether strength serves the people or merely secures his position.
cards.deeperTension: Protection and domination can share a vocabulary. Accountability reveals the difference.
cards.upright: Set clear boundaries, accept responsibility, and build structures that protect those with less power.
cards.shadowReversed: Control, inflexibility, or absent leadership may be causing harm. Revisit a rule whose purpose you cannot justify.
cards.reflection: Can the people affected by your decisions safely challenge them?
cards.artworkPrompt: An armored angel king on stone throne protects a city; a crimson demonic conqueror is reflected in his polished shield
cards.reversed: Control, inflexibility, or absent leadership may be causing harm. Revisit a rule whose purpose you cannot justify.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.scene: A celestial teacher offers sacred wisdom to two human students while a demonic shadow twists a broken scripture behind
cards.subtitle: Faith Under Examination
cards.coreMeaning: The Hierophant carries teachings through the battlefield of belief. His task is to preserve wisdom while recognizing how institutions can distort it.
cards.deeperTension: Belonging can strengthen conscience or ask it to fall silent.
cards.upright: Learn from a trustworthy tradition, mentor, or community. Ask how its teachings are practiced and whom they include.
cards.shadowReversed: Rigid doctrine, spiritual superiority, or rejection of all guidance may be clouding discernment. Examine the teaching and its effects.
cards.reflection: Which inherited belief earns your trust through what it helps people do?
cards.artworkPrompt: A celestial teacher offers sacred wisdom to two human students while a demonic shadow twists a broken scripture behind
cards.reversed: Rigid doctrine, spiritual superiority, or rejection of all guidance may be clouding discernment. Examine the teaching and its effects.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.scene: Two human lovers join hands under an angel's blessing as a serpent demon offers a jeweled temptation; conscious moral choice
cards.subtitle: Love As a Choice
cards.coreMeaning: The Lovers face an offer that would purchase comfort at the cost of integrity. Their union rests on a shared choice, freely made and honestly understood.
cards.deeperTension: Desire and commitment are related, but neither excuses deception.
cards.upright: Choose in line with your values. Make agreements explicit and respect the other person's right to decide.
cards.shadowReversed: Conflicting loyalties, secrecy, or self-betrayal may be dividing you. Tell the truth before asking for closeness.
cards.reflection: What choice would let affection and integrity remain together?
cards.artworkPrompt: Two human lovers join hands under an angel's blessing as a serpent demon offers a jeweled temptation; conscious moral choice
cards.reversed: Conflicting loyalties, secrecy, or self-betrayal may be dividing you. Tell the truth before asking for closeness.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.scene: A determined celestial warrior drives a chariot pulled by one ivory and one obsidian supernatural steed; mastery of opposing impulses
cards.subtitle: Direction Over Division
cards.coreMeaning: The Chariot moves because its driver gives opposing forces a common direction. Victory requires discipline, not the destruction of every uncomfortable impulse.
cards.deeperTension: Resolve becomes dangerous when movement matters more than the destination.
cards.upright: Name a worthwhile objective and coordinate your energy toward it. Keep your methods consistent with your purpose.
cards.shadowReversed: Aggression, scattered effort, or obsession with winning may be driving the vehicle. Slow down enough to regain direction.
cards.reflection: Is your determination serving your values or your need to prevail?
cards.artworkPrompt: A determined celestial warrior drives a chariot pulled by one ivory and one obsidian supernatural steed; mastery of opposing impulses

cards.name: Strength
cards.scene: A compassionate angel gently calms a powerful horned demon beast with open hands; courage and restraint
cards.subtitle: The Courage to Restrain
cards.coreMeaning: Strength meets the beast without surrendering to its violence. Compassion does not erase danger; it brings calm judgment to a moment that could become cruelty.
cards.deeperTension: Gentleness requires boundaries, and restraint does not require tolerating harm.
cards.upright: Respond firmly and calmly. Use only the force the situation requires, and keep your capacity for compassion.
cards.shadowReversed: Suppressed anger, intimidation, or exhaustion may be weakening self-command. Seek support and choose a safe boundary.
cards.reflection: Where could restraint protect more than retaliation would?
cards.artworkPrompt: A compassionate angel gently calms a powerful horned demon beast with open hands; courage and restraint
cards.reversed: Suppressed anger, intimidation, or exhaustion may be weakening self-command. Seek support and choose a safe boundary.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.scene: A solitary elder angel carries one lantern with a luminous star through a ruined battlefield, illuminating a safe path
cards.subtitle: A Light Kept Honest
cards.coreMeaning: The Hermit carries a small light through the wreckage of grand certainties. He seeks understanding before returning with guidance others can actually use.
cards.deeperTension: Solitude can clarify conscience or shelter it from correction.
cards.upright: Step back from noise, examine your motives, and consult a source of grounded wisdom.
cards.shadowReversed: Isolation, superiority, or endless searching may be delaying needed contact. Let a trusted person challenge your conclusions.
cards.reflection: What becomes clearer when you stop performing certainty?
cards.artworkPrompt: A solitary elder angel carries one lantern with a luminous star through a ruined battlefield, illuminating a safe path
cards.reversed: Isolation, superiority, or endless searching may be delaying needed contact. Let a trusted person challenge your conclusions.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.scene: A great gold wheel turns between ascending angels and falling demons beneath a cosmic sky; consequence and change
cards.subtitle: Consequences in Motion
cards.coreMeaning: The wheel lifts and lowers figures from both realms. Its turning represents change, chance, and the consequences that outlast a single victory.
cards.deeperTension: Not every outcome is deserved. Agency exists within circumstances you do not control.
cards.upright: Adapt to the changing conditions and act where you have influence. Notice a repeating pattern before it turns again.
cards.shadowReversed: Fatalism or a refusal to adapt may keep you inside an old cycle. Separate chance from choices you can change.
cards.reflection: Which part of the cycle can you interrupt through your own actions?
cards.artworkPrompt: A great gold wheel turns between ascending angels and falling demons beneath a cosmic sky; consequence and change
cards.reversed: Fatalism or a refusal to adapt may keep you inside an old cycle. Separate chance from choices you can change.

cards.name: Justice
cards.scene: A stern angel judge holds balanced scales and an upright sword; one pan holds a white feather, the other a black claw; equal accountability
cards.subtitle: Truth Without Favor
cards.coreMeaning: Justice weighs feather and claw by the same standard. She asks for evidence, proportional consequences, and accountability even when the accused belongs to your own side.
cards.deeperTension: Loyalty cannot make a harmful act harmless; punishment cannot replace repair.
cards.upright: Check the facts, hear those affected, and make a fair decision. Accept your part in the outcome.
cards.shadowReversed: Bias, denial, or vindictiveness may be wearing the mask of righteousness. Apply the standard you would want applied to you.
cards.reflection: Would your judgment change if the roles were reversed?

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.scene: A willing human hangs by one ankle from a living tree, serene luminous halo; weapons lie abandoned and angels and demons observe
cards.subtitle: The Surrender of Certainty
cards.coreMeaning: The Hanged Man lays down the weapons that have narrowed his understanding. His pause offers a different view without demanding that he abandon dignity.
cards.deeperTension: A chosen pause can reveal truth; imposed helplessness should not be romanticized.
cards.upright: Release the need to win this moment. Seek a perspective that the struggle has kept outside your view.
cards.shadowReversed: Stagnation or needless self-sacrifice may be mistaken for spiritual growth. Clarify what the waiting serves.
cards.reflection: What could you learn by loosening one cherished assumption?
cards.artworkPrompt: A willing human hangs by one ankle from a living tree, serene luminous halo; weapons lie abandoned and angels and demons observe
cards.reversed: Stagnation or needless self-sacrifice may be mistaken for spiritual growth. Clarify what the waiting serves.

cards.name: Death
cards.scene: A skeletal winged rider crosses a burned battlefield toward sunrise; old banners fall and white flowers rise; transformation without gore
cards.subtitle: The End of an Old Allegiance
cards.coreMeaning: Death crosses a battlefield where exhausted loyalties can no longer sustain life. The white flowers show that an ending can make room for a different future.
cards.deeperTension: Grief and renewal can coexist. Change does not require pretending the loss was easy.
cards.upright: Let an obsolete identity, habit, or agreement end. Make space for what can live honestly after it.
cards.shadowReversed: Clinging to a broken arrangement may be extending its harm. Name the loss and seek support for the transition.
cards.reflection: What has already ended that you are still trying to preserve?
cards.artworkPrompt: A skeletal winged rider crosses a burned battlefield toward sunrise; old banners fall and white flowers rise; transformation without gore
cards.reversed: Clinging to a broken arrangement may be extending its harm. Name the loss and seek support for the transition.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.scene: A guardian angel pours luminous water between exactly two cups at the boundary of a heavenly river and infernal fire
cards.subtitle: The Work of Reconciliation
cards.coreMeaning: Temperance joins two currents without allowing either to erase the other. Healing requires proportion, patience, and repeated adjustments.
cards.deeperTension: Peace is durable when it addresses harm; agreement alone does not establish healing.
cards.upright: Combine strengths carefully, repair what you can, and allow progress to develop at a sustainable pace.
cards.shadowReversed: Excess, rushed compromise, or avoidance of conflict may be disturbing the balance. Address the underlying need.
cards.reflection: Which small adjustment would make this situation more sustainable?
cards.artworkPrompt: A guardian angel pours luminous water between exactly two cups at the boundary of a heavenly river and infernal fire
cards.reversed: Excess, rushed compromise, or avoidance of conflict may be disturbing the balance. Address the underlying need.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.scene: A magnificent horned demon on obsidian throne holds loose chains around two humans who can remove them; temptation and bondage
cards.subtitle: The Chain That Can Open
cards.coreMeaning: The Devil offers power and pleasure while hiding their price. The loose chains reveal attachment, coercion, and the possibility of seeking freedom.
cards.deeperTension: Desire is not inherently wrong. The warning lies in deception, loss of choice, and harm.
cards.upright: Name the bargain you are making and its actual cost. Reclaim one area of choice and seek support where needed.
cards.shadowReversed: A loosening bond may make freedom possible, or denial may tighten it. Avoid replacing one controlling arrangement with another.
cards.reflection: What keeps you attached, and what would help you leave safely?
cards.artworkPrompt: A magnificent horned demon on obsidian throne holds loose chains around two humans who can remove them; temptation and bondage
cards.reversed: A loosening bond may make freedom possible, or denial may tighten it. Avoid replacing one controlling arrangement with another.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.scene: Lightning strikes a corrupt black citadel crowned with a false halo; winged figures fall as divine light reveals hidden corruption
cards.subtitle: The Fall of False Holiness
cards.coreMeaning: The Tower loses the crown that concealed its corruption. Revelation can be painful because a whole structure of belonging depended on not seeing.
cards.deeperTension: Collapse exposes a problem; it does not automatically provide a good replacement.
cards.upright: Face the evidence, protect immediate needs, and rebuild on principles that can withstand scrutiny.
cards.shadowReversed: Denying clear warning signs may worsen a crisis. If disruption has already come, stabilize before making sweeping promises.
cards.reflection: What truth could your present structure no longer contain?
cards.artworkPrompt: Lightning strikes a corrupt black citadel crowned with a false halo; winged figures fall as divine light reveals hidden corruption
cards.reversed: Denying clear warning signs may worsen a crisis. If disruption has already come, stabilize before making sweeping promises.

cards.name: The Star
cards.scene: A hopeful angel kneels beside a healing spring beneath one large eight-pointed star and seven smaller stars; pours from two vessels
cards.subtitle: Hope After the Battle
cards.coreMeaning: The Star restores water to wounded ground. Hope appears as quiet replenishment, truthful encouragement, and the willingness to begin healing.
cards.deeperTension: Hope needs room for grief and limits; forced optimism can silence real pain.
cards.upright: Accept help, nourish your reserves, and take a restorative step without demanding instant recovery.
cards.shadowReversed: Discouragement or dependence on a distant rescue may be obscuring available support. Look for a small reliable source of care.
cards.reflection: What gives you reason to keep tending the future?

cards.name: The Moon
cards.scene: A silver moon lights a deceptive road between celestial and infernal watchtowers; white wolf and black hound, creature rises from water
cards.subtitle: The Road Through Uncertainty
cards.coreMeaning: The Moon illuminates a path where shadows resemble threats and promises. The traveler must distinguish fear, imagination, and evidence.
cards.deeperTension: Anxiety may signal vulnerability without accurately identifying its cause.
cards.upright: Move carefully, gather information, and avoid irreversible conclusions while key facts remain unclear.
cards.shadowReversed: Confusion may be clearing, or a comforting illusion may be resisting examination. Verify before accusing or committing.
cards.reflection: Which belief about this situation has not yet been checked?
cards.artworkPrompt: A silver moon lights a deceptive road between celestial and infernal watchtowers; white wolf and black hound, creature rises from water
cards.reversed: Confusion may be clearing, or a comforting illusion may be resisting examination. Verify before accusing or committing.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.scene: A joyful human child rides a white horse beneath a radiant sun; angelic wings shelter a garden reborn after war
cards.subtitle: Goodness in the Open
cards.coreMeaning: The Sun returns life to a garden after war. Its warmth represents clarity, shared joy, and the freedom to live without constantly hiding.
cards.deeperTension: Visibility is healing when it makes space for everyone, not only the triumphant.
cards.upright: Celebrate real progress, communicate plainly, and share the benefits of success.
cards.shadowReversed: Forced cheerfulness, pride, or fear of being seen may be interrupting joy. Allow honest feelings alongside gratitude.
cards.reflection: Who can share in the good that has become possible?
cards.artworkPrompt: A joyful human child rides a white horse beneath a radiant sun; angelic wings shelter a garden reborn after war
cards.reversed: Forced cheerfulness, pride, or fear of being seen may be interrupting joy. Allow honest feelings alongside gratitude.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.scene: A great angel sounds a trumpet as humans rise from shattered armor across a battlefield, answering a call to accountability and renewal
cards.subtitle: The Call to Answer
cards.coreMeaning: Judgement summons people to face what they have done and what they can become. Renewal follows honest reckoning rather than a declaration of innocence.
cards.deeperTension: Responsibility is different from permanent condemnation. Repair requires action.
cards.upright: Acknowledge the truth, respond to a meaningful calling, and make a concrete step toward repair.
cards.shadowReversed: Avoidance or relentless self-condemnation may keep you from answering. Replace vague guilt with a specific responsibility.
cards.reflection: What would answering honestly require you to do next?
cards.artworkPrompt: A great angel sounds a trumpet as humans rise from shattered armor across a battlefield, answering a call to accountability and renewal
cards.reversed: Avoidance or relentless self-condemnation may keep you from answering. Replace vague guilt with a specific responsibility.

cards.name: The World
cards.scene: A luminous human soul surrounded by an oval wreath of white feathers and dark thorns; four corner guardians, restored wholeness
cards.subtitle: Wholeness Beyond Victory
cards.coreMeaning: The World gathers the journey into a wider belonging. Its wreath holds the knowledge of both realms without giving cruelty equal authority.
cards.deeperTension: Completion includes limits and unresolved history; it does not require moral perfection.
cards.upright: Recognize what has been learned, honor the contributions of others, and bring this chapter to a thoughtful close.
cards.shadowReversed: An unfinished obligation or fear of moving on may be keeping the cycle open. Complete the remaining work without seeking perfection.
cards.reflection: What can you carry forward without carrying the whole battle?
cards.artworkPrompt: A luminous human soul surrounded by an oval wreath of white feathers and dark thorns; four corner guardians, restored wholeness
cards.reversed: An unfinished obligation or fear of moving on may be keeping the cycle open. Complete the remaining work without seeking perfection.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.scene: An angelic hand emerging from clouds offers ONE living wand aflame with sacred gold fire

horoscope_cards.coreMeaning: Pisces makes room for sensitivity, compassion, and the images that connect experience in unexpected ways. A creative or intuitive response can reveal a feeling that ordinary explanation has missed. Keep an anchor in the present while exploring it. Pisces lets imagination accompany an absence without becoming a substitute for living. Compassion can honor what remains unresolved while keeping clear shores.
